title: I built a trading journal where AI reviews your process instead of predicting the market
author: Pretend_Physics_7493
selftext:
Most “AI for trading” products lead with signals or predictions. I took the opposite direction: use AI after the trade to examine the trader’s own process.



I built TheProfitPath around a review loop:



• log the trade, chart, setup, and context

• record the plan, execution, and emotion

• find repeated behaviors across sessions

• turn the review into one concrete rule for the next session



The AI tutor is intended to help question reasoning and surface patterns from that journal—not tell someone what to buy or promise returns. The rest of the product includes analytics, playbooks, goals, reports, emotion tracking, accounts, and an economic calendar.



The core journal is free and doesn’t require a credit card. I’m the builder, so this is transparent self-promotion:



[https://theprofitpath.app](https://theprofitpath.app)



I’d especially value feedback from people already using LLMs in their trading workflow: what would make an AI review feel genuinely useful without crossing into bad financial advice?
